note: The main banks were taken as Moldova's three largest by assets, a choice from general knowledge (no central bank or association ranking was read in this pass): maib, Moldindconbank and Victoriabank. Victoriabank: its credit card list and its STAR Card and STAR Card Platinum pages, read 2026-10-30; its other cards in that list are debit cards or overdrafts on salary and social accounts, not written. Both bear a floating 16.19% a year with up to 56 days of grace; each card linked to the account costs nothing in its first year, which is introductory, then 100 lei a year (STAR Card) or 1,000 lei (Platinum). Cash at ATMs and counter POS costs 2%. The pages state no minimum payment, foreign-currency fee or late charge. maib and Moldindconbank answered with bot checks on the earlier reading and weren't retried.
